body:
This PR allows us to propagate `Dual` numbers from `ForwardDiff.jl` through the `find_zero` function.

Specifically, the `SolutionTolerance` is allowed to have a different number type than the input `x`. While this type was previously set to `eltype(typeof(x))`, it is now set to `base_type(typeof(x))`, where the `base_type` function recursively determines the "base" number type (typically `Float32` or `Float64`).

This PR also bumps the minor version number from `0.4.1` to `0.4.2`.
title: Widen allowable types for Dual number inputs
